title: Calm shadow intent: two phases, one stream, no send

strategy_identity_proof.method: same detector, same frame, before and after the extraction; digest over day, direction, signal time, entry time, entry price, prior session and all four features
strategy_identity_proof.self_check: asserted set-up count > 0 before comparing; an all-None baseline would pass any refactor
strategy_identity_proof.clock_note: the digest window is the raw UTC parquet; the comparison is clock-independent because the same frame goes through both runs. The end-to-end run uses the route's own loader, which converts to New York.

scheduler_inventory.method: real make_scheduler construction in one process; the pre-stage slot table reconstructed in memory for the before row
scheduler_inventory.phase_passed_in_argv: only for a slot that has one; the three unsplit sleeves' argv is byte-identical, measured

end_to_end_run.driven_through: observe_live_slot — the function the scheduler calls

design_changes_forced_by_measurement.finding: the Calm detector returns nothing when today has no 10:00 bar
design_changes_forced_by_measurement.consequence_if_unfixed: a DECIDE slot calling the ordinary candidate path receives an empty list every morning and records 'Calm did not set up today' on every day of its life
design_changes_forced_by_measurement.resolution: the rule split at the point it actually divides; the full detector is built ON the shared pre-entry half rather than beside it

design_changes_forced_by_measurement.finding: sleeves_at(09:32) and sleeves_at(10:02) are both empty; Calm's window is the single instant 10:00
design_changes_forced_by_measurement.resolution: neither phase goes through the candidate path; OBSERVE runs no detector at all, because the setup was found half an hour earlier and written down

design_changes_forced_by_measurement.finding: the first OBSERVE refusal row carried 'gate_refused' when the gate had passed and the source refused
design_changes_forced_by_measurement.consequence_if_unfixed: a reader is sent to inspect a gate that was working
design_changes_forced_by_measurement.resolution: refusal rows carry the slot's own vocabulary

design_changes_forced_by_measurement.finding: the first draft passed --phase for every slot, including the three unsplit sleeves
design_changes_forced_by_measurement.caught_by: regression: a test asserting Calm and Stress argv are unchanged
design_changes_forced_by_measurement.consequence_if_unfixed: the command line of three sleeves this stage does not touch would have changed
design_changes_forced_by_measurement.resolution: the phase appears only for a slot that has one; the reasoning about naming the half does not extend to a sleeve with no halves

dashboard.current: absent — the two Calm phases have not run

mutations_cover: shadow intent written to the orders dir
failures_while_writing: a count over raw source read the function's own docstring as code; the reader now strips docstrings
the decide-row builder cannot be asked for a price at all, so the refusal lives one layer down; the test now proves both doors

findings_recorded_not_fixed.what: signal diagnostics have never carried a parameter identity
findings_recorded_not_fixed.why: the reader guards on the parameter module having a hash function; it never had one. The real function lives in the route-params module and takes a full configuration rather than a sleeve name, refusing a partial one outright.
findings_recorded_not_fixed.effect: every diagnostics row since the field existed carries an empty identity; two rows compare equal because both are blank

findings_recorded_not_fixed.what: the order journal's path is defined independently in three modules
findings_recorded_not_fixed.guard: a test asserts they still agree

live_runtime_during_stage.cause: the overnight Nikkei window closing; the route wrote its own state
live_runtime_during_stage.note: the fourth window close the Stage 5ZS book repair has survived

remaining_before_paper: PAPER_SHADOW_EVIDENCE — 3 judgeable days of 5, and 0 of them carry Calm evidence
B1 — no decision recorded; its measurement expires 24h after it was taken
the SEND wire — does not exist and this stage did not build it

regression.method: the same failures re-run with the pre-stage slot table restored through a probe fixture; 45 went green

order_dependence_found.observed: the same set produced 109 failures then 98
order_dependence_found.meaning: eleven tests pass or fail depending on what ran before them
order_dependence_found.scope: a property of the corpus, not of this stage
order_dependence_found.implication: any failure count from it carries about ten per cent of noise

repaired_because_not_stale_pins.what: two causal-path AST assertions (5ZU test_20, 5ZV test_7)
repaired_because_not_stale_pins.why: the property moved rather than broke; the causal path is now two functions
repaired_because_not_stale_pins.repair: counted across both halves AND per half
repaired_because_not_stale_pins.mutation_proof: 3 mutations confirmed red, including a 2/0 split that a total-only count would pass

repaired_because_not_stale_pins.why: a clean shadow period now includes Calm decision evidence
repaired_because_not_stale_pins.note: they went red before the fixture grew it, which is the natural mutation proof that the new check can refuse

left_red_and_listed.why_not_repaired: the count pins are the roster anti-pattern already on record, and the tests that drive the old slot exercise 10:00 semantics that no longer exist — repairing them means deciding per test what the new Calm timing should mean, which would weaken assertions inside a stage nobody asked to weaken them in
